hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && dotnet format OrdersSaga.slnx --verify-no-changes && dotnet test --solution OrdersSaga.slnx && while IFS= read -r proj; do if dotnet list "$proj" package --vulnerable --include-transitive --format json | grep -q '"vulnerabilities"'; then echo "Paquete vulnerable encontrado en $proj" >&2; exit 2; fi; done < <(find src tests -name '*.csproj') || exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Pre-commit: dotnet format, dotnet test y escaneo de vulnerabilidades...
